Resolves #4531

In `Neo.component.wrapper.GoogleMaps#afterSetMounted`, re-invokes `onMarkerStoreLoad()` once `Neo.main.addon.GoogleMaps.create(opts)` resolves whenever `markerStore.getCount() > 0`, and resets `this.mapCreated = false` inside `removeMap()` so unmounting and remounting a `GoogleMaps` wrapper re-renders its existing `markerStore` markers onto the new map instance.

Evidence: L1 (Playwright single-thread unit test in `test/playwright/unit/component/GoogleMapsMarkerRemovals.spec.mjs` verifying `mounted: true -> false -> true` re-renders `markerStore` markers after `GoogleMaps.create`) → L1 required (component wrapper mount/unmount/remount lifecycle).

Micro-review eligible: single-file defect fix (`src/component/wrapper/GoogleMaps.mjs` + unit test) — `afterSetMounted` checks `me.markerStore?.getCount() > 0` after map creation and `removeMap` resets `this.mapCreated = false`.

`agent-preflight`: not hosted here; baseline `PR body`, `Commit authorship`, and `Engine Tests` ran.

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | `test/playwright/unit/component/GoogleMapsMarkerRemovals.spec.mjs` (`re-renders markerStore markers when unmounted and mounted again`) |

## Deltas from ticket
- Also resets `this.mapCreated = false` inside `removeMap()` so `mapCreated` accurately reflects the unmounted state after `Neo.main.addon.GoogleMaps.removeMap()` deletes the map instance.
